es.summary: Las membranas (bolsa amniótica) se rompen solas, sin intervención, y sale líquido amniótico por la vagina. Puede ocurrir antes o durante el trabajo de parto.
key_points: Lo contrario es RAMO (ruptura artificial); mientras están sanas se anotan como MOI (membranas íntegras).
Si ocurre antes del inicio del trabajo de parto se llama RPM (ruptura prematura de membranas).
El líquido normal es claro; verde o amarillo indica meconio.
Tras la ruptura aumenta el riesgo de infección (corioamnionitis) y de prolapso del cordón.

usage: Ejemplo: «REMO a las 14:30, líquido claro, sin mal olor, abundante».
Se confirma por inspección (salida o acumulación de líquido) o con pruebas de pH o cristalización (helecho).
nursing_care: Valorar la FCF inmediatamente después de la ruptura para descartar prolapso del cordón.
Anotar hora, color, olor y cantidad del líquido.
Vigilar la temperatura y signos de infección; limitar los tactos vaginales.
Cambiar apósitos con frecuencia y mantener la higiene perineal.

en.summary: The amniotic membranes break on their own, without intervention, and amniotic fluid leaks from the vagina (REMO in Spanish). It can happen before or during labor.
key_points: The opposite is RAMO (artificial rupture, AROM); while still whole they are charted as MOI (intact membranes).
If it happens before labor starts it is called PROM (RPM in Spanish).
Amniotic fluid is expected to be clear; green or yellow color is associated with meconium-stained fluid.
After rupture, the risk of infection (chorioamnionitis) and cord prolapse increases.

usage: Example: "SROM at 14:30, clear fluid, no odor, large amount".
Confirmed through visual inspection (leaking or pooling of fluid) or by testing the fluid for ferning or pH.
nursing_care: Check the FHR right after rupture to rule out cord prolapse.
Document the time of the rupture of membranes, the color of the fluid, any odor and the amount.
Monitor temperature and signs of infection; limit vaginal exams.
Change pads often and keep perineal hygiene.

sources.name: Maternal-Newborn Nursing: Nursing Care during the First Stage of Labor
Maternal-Newborn Nursing: Factors Influencing the Process of Labor and Birth

key_points.2.quote: Amniotic fluid is expected to be clear.

sections.usage.1.quote: The assessment may include the laboring person’s report of a gush or leaking of fluid before arrival, visual inspection of the vagina for pooling, or laboratory testing of the fluid for ferning or pH.
